claims.statement: For independent X,Y,Z with densities <=1 and B=[[0,a,b],[a,0,c],[b,c,0]] invertible, every affine perturbation of the associated quadratic has density sup <= 6|det B|^{-1/3}.

Convert balanced-cut mixed self/cross spectral resources, or the two-heavy plus one-diffuse determinant bank, into a product-preserving paid smoothing packet with universal parameters.
